- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: around 93-126; ~line 310-321 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A newer same-name check can supersede a cancelled configured CI check when both run IDs are in PR_CHECKS_CI_RUN_IDS, even if those run IDs belong to a workflow other than CI.
  WHY: PR_CHECKS_CI_RUN_IDS is populated from `actions/runs?head_sha=` filtered by `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS`, which can include multiple workflows; a successful same-name check from another listed workflow can therefore remove the cancelled CI check from the blocking set and allow a merge without a successful CI run.

  WHY: `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` puts IDs from every listed workflow into `PR_CHECKS_CI_RUN_IDS`, so a successful same-name check from another listed workflow can make the gate treat the named CI check as successful and authorize a merge without a successful CI run.
